Sci-Fi Modular Gun Pack
Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/scifimodularguns.html
Creator: Quaternius (@Quaternius)
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The game uses the Standard GLB animation library and the complete embedded
glTF gun models. Runtime code retargets locomotion to the KYX operative rig and
maps the gun models to the existing weapon definitions.
